scope: Runnable React and Flutter source supplements; labelled simulation is authorized. No carrier calls or messages.

run: React dependencies/start/build and actual browser entry
Flutter pubspec, main, native/web runners, controller/widget tests
Portable relative imports and source/reference links
contract: Use assigned E.164 caller ID, not phone record ID
Completed staff context separated from voice credential
Stable installation identity reused for renewal and unregister
AppEngine request method/path/body/query consistent with supplied Phone adapter
lifecycle: One connect owner; duplicate connect does not leak registrations or Devices
SDK registered is separate from call accepted
Listeners installed before accepting incoming call
Busy incoming call rejected without replacing active call
Mute, digits, hangup and terminal state remain linked to correct call
Stop/dispose invalidates late SDK/API callbacks and timers
Late initial registration or renewal cannot restore logged-out session
communications: Save draft versus send query option
Retain successful send result if readback fails
truth: Persistent simulation label; no microphone/provider/physical push claim
Production integration code versus fixture-only implementation clearly named
No hardcoded private organization, record credentials or token logging

execution: Only bounded offline checks; heavy browser/build/test queue requires coordination. Current producers still authoring.
